content.title: Coachella 2026: The HITS Questionnaire
content.text: In what’s become a cherished tradition at HITS and an annual nuisance for publicists, we asked some of our favorite Coachella performers to share with us remembrances of their first concerts, lurid details about their tour riders and who they can’t wait to see at this year’s desert fest.This year’s esteemed panelists are Bichota/Interscope headliner KAROL G, chart-topping Atlantic artist/producer PinkPantheress, billion-streaming Island singer-songwriter Gigi Perez, Roc Nation’s Grammy-winning hip-hop duo Clipse and Epic’s breakout MC, BIA.What’s the first concert you ever attended?KAROL G: The first concert I ever went to was in 1997, for the Venezuelan group Salserín, at La Macarena in Medellín. My parents had bought tickets, but when we got there, they turned out to be fake… My dad did everything he could to find new ones because we were so excited. We had our outfits ready, bell-bottom pants and the sandals from Las Juanas, which was a very popular TV show in Colombia at the time. In the end we made it in, with really good seats and we enjoyed it so much.PinkPantheress: Panic! at the Disco in 2015 at London Hammersmith Apollo, for my birthday.Gigi Perez: Bruno Mars in 2013 at Miami’s American Airlines Arena. It was my friend’s 13th birthday, and her mom took a bunch of us in a pink, zebra-striped limousine. The adult chaperones were definitely concerned with how much I enjoyed it.Malice, Clipse: The Run-D.M.C. and Beastie Boys Together Forever tour at the Norfolk Scope, 1987. It was actually my second concert, but it was most memorable because I waved to Run and he started to come over to where I was, until Rick Rubin told him not to “go down there!” It pissed me off terribly… Run-D.M.C. is my all-time fave!BIA: TLC on the FanMail tour at TD Garden in Boston, 2000.You can go back in time and see any concert. Which artist and when?KAROL G: I would have loved to see Selena Quintanilla live. She’s one of my idols. I remember watching her movie when I was very young and it left such a strong impression on me. It made me dream, believe that it was possible and understand the importance of family support in this journey.PinkPantheress: The first My Chemical Romance tour in 2007. They’re my favorite band, and to see them then would have been insane.Perez: Jeff Buckley at the Cabaret Metro in Chicago on May 13, 1995. My friend Nicco showed me the YouTube video and it changed my life.Pusha T, Clipse: I’d go back to 1996-97 to see The Notorious B.I.G. BIG was on a tear, going into making the best double album ever, Life After Death. I would have loved to see him perform those freestyles and remixes leading up to that amazing sophomore effort.Malice, Clipse: Michael Jackson. The best to ever do it.BIA: Aaliyah. I have always loved her style and choreography.In Dublin, a fan took off their prosthetic leg and handed it to me onstage to get signed. Have to admire their dedication!—PinkPantheressWhat’s the craziest thing you’ve ever seen while performing onstage?KAROL G: During the MAÑANA SERÁ BONITO show in Miami, right before I started singing “GATÚBELA,” I said into the mic, “Why is it so hot?” and at that exact moment, it started raining. The rain became part of the show, like it had been designed that way. Nobody panicked, on the contrary, everyone felt like they were living one of the best moments of their lives with me, dancing in the rain.PinkPantheress: In Dublin, a fan took off their prosthetic leg and handed it to me onstage to get signed. Have to admire their dedication!Pusha T, Clipse: At Coachella, the desert heat melted my DJ’s laptop onstage… It was scorchin’ that day.Malice, Clipse: On tour with the Deftones I had to stop the show three or four times due to fans passing out. I didn’t know if they were getting squished, if they were high or if they were trolling.BIA: In this really intense mosh pit in Germany there was a guy dressed in a chicken suit.What was the first Coachella you attended and who was your favorite act?KAROL G: My first time at Coachella was in 2022, performing on the main stage, and it was an incredible experience. From that moment, I knew I wanted to pay tribute to the Latin artists who opened the doors for us. Now, being a headliner at Coachella gives me the chance to keep representing my Latin community to the world.It wasn’t the same year, but in 2025 I went to see Lady Gaga. I’ve been a Little Monster for years and seeing her live—the production, the staging, the music, the storytelling and especially watching her perform—was incredibly inspiring.PinkPantheress: I went to see Basement Jaxx last year and it was incredible.BIA: I can’t remember my first Coachella, but one of my early Coachella memories was Kali Uchis bringing me out onstage to perform on her song “Miami” in 2018. From then on, I always knew that I wanted to do my own set at Coachella.Who are you most looking forward to seeing perform at this year’s Coachella?PinkPantheress: I’m super-excited to see Alex G. My friends and I had the pleasure of watching him perform at Laneway, so I’m geeked to get to see him and his band throw down again.Perez: FKA twigs, Little Simz and KAROL G.BIA: KAROL G and Justin Bieber.What’s the most “rock star” item in your rider?KAROL G: My tequila, for sure. Taking a shot of 200 Copas by Casa Dragones with my team before going onstage has become one of our traditions. But something that’s very me is having my dressing room full of candles. I’m very romantic and I like to create a calm, peaceful atmosphere.PinkPantheress: Martini olives.Perez: Nothing rock star, just ginger shots and cucumber.Pusha T, Clipse: Brazil nuts. Must have.BIA: Top-shelf tequila and chocolate-covered strawberries.Do you have a ritual right before going onstage?KAROL G: I like to connect with my whole team before going out. We hug, we celebrate and we fill ourselves with energy. Then I say a prayer and I give my show to God. I also take a few minutes alone. I enter a different state, like a transformation that only happens right before I step onstage. It’s a very powerful feeling… like a superpower that comes from the energy and love of my fans, and it’s something I even miss when I’m not on tour.PinkPantheress: I usually prioritize silence/solitude to center myself. I still get a bit frightful before performing, so I find quiet time can help get my mind ready.Perez: We always sing Celia Cruz’s “La Vida Es un Carnaval.”Malice, Clipse: We pray together that the show is successful and that our fans have a safe, enjoyable time and leave inspired!BIA: I say a prayer with the team and then take a moment by myself to just soak everything in and meditate in silence. Going onstage with a clear mind eases my nerves.What do you plan to do between Coachella weekends, and can we tag along?KAROL G: Honestly, between the two weekends we never stop. My schedule is very intense with work, rehearsals, recordings and preparing the show.PinkPantheress: I’ll be on tour all of April and May, so I’ll basically be prepping and performing between my Coachella weekends, if you don’t mind dance rehearsals!Pusha T, Clipse: My wife is scheduled to deliver our newborn on April 6, so any off time will be spent at home with the family. And no, you can’t tag along. Too germy.BIA: I plan to rage, so yeah, of course… if you can hang!
